name: Efficiency
description: Efficiency of a converter or of anything that needs one: sets the input and output conditions, sweeps any parameter, reads the input and output quantities and computes efficiency (or any other quantity) from formulas.

roles.name: instruments
roles.description: Every instrument used: sources, loads, meters, data loggers

golden.description: check the result against a golden sample of the project (a good unit of the same kind): name (in the golden/ folder of the project) or run (a run file), and tolerances = {rows: {match: [columns that pair the rows], columns: {column: tolerance}}, curves, min_overlap}

variables.description: Ordered list of parameters; the first one changes first (innermost sweep)

timing.description: settle_s after setting, then 'samples' readings 'interval_s' apart, averaged
